name: sonarr
title: Sonarr
description: Manage your Sonarr library, search for series, monitor downloads, and view upcoming shows.
author: Aayush9029

commands.name: index
commands.title: View Upcoming Shows
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: View calendar of upcoming episodes with search and monitoring actions

commands.title: Search Series
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: Search and add new TV series to your Sonarr library

commands.name: series-library
commands.title: Series Library
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: Browse your entire series collection with filters

commands.name: download-queue
commands.title: Download Queue
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: Monitor active downloads and manage the queue

commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: Review recent Sonarr activity like grabs, imports, and failures

commands.name: blocklist
commands.title: Blocklist
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: Inspect blocked releases in your Sonarr instance

commands.name: missing-episodes
commands.title: Missing Episodes
commands.subtitle: Sonarr
commands.description: View monitored episodes without files and search for them

commands.name: unmonitored-series
commands.title: Unmonitored Series
commands.subtitle: Sonarr

commands.title: Instance Status

preferences.name: instanceName
preferences.title: Instance Name
preferences.description: A friendly name for your primary Sonarr instance

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: Host
preferences.description: Hostname or IP of the Sonarr server, without the port (e.g. 192.168.0.25)

preferences.name: base
preferences.title: URL Base (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional Sonarr URL base path (e.g. sonarr if your URL is /sonarr)

preferences.name: http
preferences.title: Connection Type
preferences.description: Change the connection type for the Sonarr server

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: The API key of the Sonarr server

preferences.name: enableSecondaryInstance
preferences.title: Second Instance
preferences.description: Add a second Sonarr instance you can switch to from any command
preferences.label: Enable second Sonarr instance

preferences.name: secondaryInstanceName
preferences.title: Second Instance Name
preferences.description: A friendly name for your second Sonarr instance

preferences.name: secondaryHost
preferences.title: Second Instance Host
preferences.description: Hostname or IP of the second Sonarr server, without the port (e.g. 192.168.0.30)

preferences.name: secondaryPort
preferences.title: Second Instance Port
preferences.description: Port of the second Sonarr server (e.g. 8989)

preferences.name: secondaryBase
preferences.title: Second Instance URL Base (Optional)
preferences.description: Optional URL base path of the second Sonarr server (e.g. sonarr if your URL is /sonarr)

preferences.name: secondaryHttp
preferences.title: Second Instance Connection Type
preferences.description: Change the connection type for the second Sonarr server

preferences.name: secondaryApiKey
preferences.title: Second Instance API Key
preferences.description: The API key of the second Sonarr server

preferences.name: activeInstance
preferences.title: Active Instance
preferences.description: Which instance commands start on. Switching from a command overrides it until you change this preference again.

preferences.name: futureDays
preferences.title: Future Days
preferences.description: The number of days from now to show upcoming shows for
